text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What we need to win from here is a move 
that turns the tables all at once!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now we're talking! That gets me fired up! 
This is why I could never quit racing...!
choice_data_list: Glad to see you're staying positive!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, right? The choice I should make 
isn't fold—it's raise.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's time to train. Our next 
challenge begins right here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, she's got quite a fiery look in 
her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're on. You're gonna stay with me till 
the bitter end.
